title: StateGraph silently drops node output keys not declared in TypedDict
observed_behavior: A node returns {'x': 1, 'undeclared_key': ...} against a State that declares only 'x'. The graph completes with {'x': 1}; the undeclared key is filtered out before the Pregel merge, with no warning or error.
structure_focus: Node return patch vs declared state schema; silent boundary filtering of undeclared keys
notes: Open, labels bug/external. Minimal single-node graph; the reported problem is the silent filtering in the node-return-to-state boundary, not the graph topology. The issue asks for a warning or an opt-in strict mode, so the fix direction is a diagnostic feature; comments trace the drop to _get_updates and several PR attempts add a UserWarning. Classified as framework because the gap is in how the framework validates node output against the declared schema.
